watcherAutoStart.description: If true, the install script ensures the OpenClaw subagent-runs watcher launchd job is loaded so chimes fire on OpenClaw run state transitions. Default: true.

runsPath.description: Override path to the OpenClaw subagent runs registry. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/subagents/runs.json.

perAgentSound.description: Override the per-agent sound (built-in macOS sound name like Glass, or absolute path).

allCompleteSound.description: Override the all-complete sound (built-in macOS sound name like Hero, or absolute path).
